teams.detail: No game until the Apple Cup opener vs. Washington State, now moved to Sunday, Sept. 6 (1 p.m. PT, NBC). Jedd Fisch's staff has added a 4-star cornerback, its highest-rated 2026 commitment, along with a 4-star safety, as it builds toward year two in Seattle.

Washington is one of four finalists for 5-star guard Dylan Mingo as Danny Sprinkle's staff continues rebuilding around a heavy international pipeline, headlined by Croatian forward Boris Tisma. Jasir Rencher looks healthy - shooting, driving and lifting - in offseason workout footage.

Rookies reported to training camp Friday, led by first-round RB Jadarian Price, who projects for a heavy workload - including kick returns - after Kenneth Walker left in free agency and Zach Charbonnet's ACL recovery continues. Veterans and nine public practices begin July 25 in Renton, with Football Fest set for Aug. 8 at Lumen Field.

Detroit's Summer League ended Friday in a 101-87 loss to Miami after blowing an 11-point halftime lead, getting outscored 35-15 in the fourth. Ebuka Okorie led the Pistons with 27 points as Detroit finished 1-4 in Las Vegas; the offseason additions of John Collins (3 yrs, $51M) and a trade for Jrue Holiday remain the bigger story ahead of training camp.

Seattle fell 7-0 to San Francisco on Friday as Willy Adames hit a grand slam and Landen Roupp threw seven sharp innings for the Giants. The Mariners (48-49, 2nd in the AL West, holding a wild-card spot) host the rematch tonight at T-Mobile Park, first pitch 5:08 p.m. PT, Bryan Woo vs. Logan Webb.

headlines.headline: Louisville lands two of the portal's best in Flory Bidunga and Jackson Shelstad as Pat Kelsey reloads
headlines.detail: Louisville added Kansas big man Flory Bidunga, 247Sports' top-ranked player in the transfer portal, and Oregon guard Jackson Shelstad in the same week. Kansas countered with former Utah forward Keanu Dawes (12.5 ppg, 8.8 rpg) and Duke landed former Wisconsin guard John Blackwell (19.1 ppg on 59.3% true shooting).

headlines.headline: Clippers rally past Timberwolves in overtime to reach the NBA Summer League championship game
headlines.detail: The Clippers beat the Timberwolves 128-120 in OT behind Keaton Wagler's 26 points and Sean Pedulla's 24 points and 11 assists, sending Los Angeles to Sunday's championship game on ESPN.

headlines.headline: NFL suspends Cardinals scouting executive Ryan Gold indefinitely for leaking 2026 draft picks and gambling
headlines.detail: Arizona's director of college scouting was suspended after sharing confidential 2026 draft-selection information and placing parlay bets on NFL and college games. Separately, Tennessee's Jeffery Simmons became the NFL's highest-paid defensive tackle on a three-year, $105.8 million deal with $100 million guaranteed.

headlines.headline: SEC Media Days open Monday in Tampa with Lane Kiffin's LSU debut and six new head coaches headlining
headlines.detail: The four-day event kicks off Monday with Lane Kiffin appearing for the first time as LSU's coach after leaving Ole Miss mid-Playoff-run, part of a six-new-coach class that also includes Kentucky's Will Stein and Florida's Jon Sumrall.
